title: Simple Actors and Deep Critics for Scalable Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.26659v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent progress in offline reinforcement learning (RL) has been driven by expressive generative actors such as diffusion and flow-matching policies, which capture multimodal behavior in offline datasets. However, these actors require multiple denoising or integration steps per action and thus incur substantial overhead at every decision in deployment. In this work, we revisit where capacity should be invested in an offline actor--critic method. Since the critic is used only during training and is discarded at deployment while the actor runs at every decision step, allocating capacity to the critic rather than the actor is more favorable for inference-time efficiency. However, scaling MLP critics in offline RL is known to introduce several distinct instabilities that have, in practice, kept critics shallow. translated_title: 简单Actor与深度Critic用于可扩展强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26659v1 公告类型：新 摘要：离线强化学习（RL）的最新进展由表达性生成式Actor驱动，如扩散和流匹配策略，这些策略能够捕获离线数据集中的多模态行为。然而，这些Actor在每次动作中需要多次去噪或积分步骤，从而在部署时的每个决策中产生大量开销。在本工作中，我们重新审视了离线Actor-Critic方法中容量应投资于何处。由于Critic仅在训练期间使用，在部署时被丢弃，而Actor在每个决策步骤中运行，因此将容量分配给Critic而非Actor更有利于推理时的效率。然而，在离线RL中扩展MLP Critic已知会引入几种不同的不稳定性，这些不稳定性在实践中导致Critic保持浅层。我们识别了离线RL中加深Critic时出现的三种不同失败模式——优化、自举噪声放大以及目标传播问题。基于这些见解，我们提出了一种简单而有效的架构，该架构结合了浅层Actor和深度Critic，在不牺牲性能的情况下实现了显著的计算节省。我们的方法在D4RL基准测试中展示了最先进的结果，同时相比基于扩散的策略，推理速度提高了10倍以上。
tldr: 本文提出了一种简单Actor与深度Critic的架构，通过将计算容量分配给训练阶段的Critic而非部署阶段的Actor，在离线RL中实现高性能的同时将推理速度提升10倍以上。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a simple-actor-deep-critic architecture that allocates capacity to the training-only critic rather than the deployment-time actor, achieving state-of-the-art performance in offline RL while improving inference speed by over 10x.
